title: Trace table set (three programs)
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Programming 2: data structures, files and subprograms
source: Seeded from computing/y10 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: trace table set (three programs))
intro: Lesson 12: Operators and trace tables core. To understand how arithmetic, relational and logical operators work and how a trace table shows a program's values

questions.model: I do: 20 // 6: how many whole 6s in 20: 3. 20 % 6: remainder 2. 20 / 6 = 3.33. 2 ** 5 = 32.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: complete trace tables for three short programs, including one with a while loop and a logical operator.
questions.a: Answers on the pupil PDF answer key in the plan (e.g. program 1 output 6; program 2 output 15; program 3 output 'Valid').
questions.model: The teacher fills the first row of program 1's trace table.

questions.q: Extend: write a condition true only for ages 13 to 19 inclusive.
Stretch: what is the output of print(7 // 2 * 2 + 7 % 2)?
Back to our ponder: How can you be sure what a program will do without running it?
questions.a: Trace it: follow each line and record each variable's value in a trace table.
